mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as reduced borrowing costs stimulate corporate investment and equity valuations through lower discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.1% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing forward S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.1%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a negative predictor is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market strength that may trigger Federal Reserve policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS-UNRATE interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 700 thousand units signal economic overheating and potential policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST > 700, or the Rank IC for HOUST in late-cycle regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8.0% signals economic weakness and potential fiscal stimulus, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index above 225 indicates elevated inflation, prompting Federal Reserve policy tightening that reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail and food services sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is above its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.
